items.content_text: Chinese military researchers fear that AI advances could give the US an edge in the nuclear balance of power. Experts in China worry that artificial intelligence could make it easier for US forces to detect and destroy Chinese nuclear missiles, according to a New York Times analysis. That would undermine China's deterrence strategy, which relies on a guaranteed second-strike capability.
